extension.description: Installs repositories and add-ons for a personal Kodi build.
extension.news: v1.0.18: Adds an end-of-setup restart prompt so the freshly installed add-ons load cleanly (fixes the Fire Stick end-of-setup freeze). You choose Restart now / Later; on desktop Kodi restarts itself, on Android/Fire Stick it asks you to fully close and reopen. (v1.0.17 added Multi Weather and IPTV Simple Client and removed the unknown-sources toggle so no security prompt appears. v1.0.14 fixed the "Registering add-ons" freeze via direct-extract + enable.)
